name: Investor follow-up answers
prompt: Draft answers to the investor's follow-up questions in {root}/questions.md. Read the vault first for every number, name and status. Write the draft at {target} in plain words for Joe to edit. Do not send anything.
target: investors/<firm>/<partner>/Reply Draft — 2026-09-02 — Joe edits before send.md
claim: The reply draft answers each question from vault facts, in plain words, and waits for Joe.
rubric: Each question in the list gets a direct answer.
Every number, name and status comes from the vault, not from memory.
The prose is plain, with no filler or self-praise.
The draft is saved for Joe's edit and nothing was sent.
source: investors/<firm>/<partner>/Reply Draft — 2026-09-02 — Joe edits before send.md
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
